build_dataset_cater_with_masks: build a tf.data pipeline to read and parse CATER TFRecords with masks for multi-object video sequences
create_feature_descriptions: create feature descriptions for parsing CATER TFRecord examples with camera matrices, images, masks, and object positions
decode_cater_example: decode a single CATER TFRecord example into reshaped image, mask, camera matrix, and object position tensors
test_cater_dataset_reader: test the CATER dataset reader to verify TFRecord parsing produces correctly shaped image and mask tensors
summarize_cater_dataset: summarize the CATER dataset reader module that reads compressed TFRecords and returns unbatched tf.data pipelines
